Name: HmmCheeseYum
Author: tomasitobambito
Description:
[size=6][center]Mod Description[size=6][/size][size=2]
This mod includes all sorts of changes around the two cheese items. The main changes include making cheese overpowered and adding a new cheese ore.[/size][/center][/size][size=2]
[center][size=6]Installation Instructions[/size][/center][/size][list]
[*][size=2]To download the entire mod, download the main file (this requires Content Patcher and Custom Ore Nodes)[/size]
[*][size=2]To download only the cheese ore, download the Custom Cheese Ore file from the miscellaneous section (this only requires Custom Ore Nodes)[/size]
[*][size=2]To download only the gameplay changes, download the Gameplay Changes file from the miscellaneous section (this only requires Content Patcher)[/size]
[*][size=2]Drop the .zip file in your mods folder and unpack it (it will be normal that it shows up as multiple folders)[/size]
[*][size=2]When the game launches it will tell you that you are launching 5 mods (if all requirements and no other mods are installed) this was done as the mod works with two different kinds of content packs and a regular mod file.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][center][size=6]Detailed Changes[/size][/center]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Multiplied cheese selling price by 10[/size]
[*][size=2]Multiplied selling price of cheese cauliflower by 10[/size]
[*][size=2]Eating any kind of cheese adds a lot of buffs[/size]
[*][size=2]Cheese, goat cheese and cheese cauliflower are now universally loved gifts[/size]
[*][size=2]Cheese Ore added (see below for exact details)[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][center][size=6]Cheese Ore[/size][/center]
[/size][size=2]Cheese ore is a new ore that has been added to all floors in both the regular mines and skull cavern. It always drops between 2 and 5 cheese and has a 50% chance of dropping between 1 and 3 goat cheese. Approximately 5% of all stones in the mines are replaced with cheese ore. [/size]

Downloads.Description: This file contains all parts of the mod. It requires both content patcher and custom ore nodes.
